body.title: Live-test the refusal and success paths against the real codex binary
body.summary: Add INSRC_LIVE_TESTS=1-gated live tests: a real runReadOnlySession call whose discovered servers include codex_app or cua_repl throws CodexMcpServerOverrideUnsafeError naming that server and never starts a session (no tool from any server reachable); a real call whose discovered servers include node_repl (and insrc) succeeds and starts a restricted session as today; confirm the previously-covered misregistration, budget/cancellation, and project-config-refusal live tests remain unaffected.
acceptanceChecks: live: codex_app or cua_repl in the discovered servers list throws CodexMcpServerOverrideUnsafeError naming that server, no session starts
live: node_repl in the discovered servers list starts a restricted session successfully, as today
live: existing misregistration / budget-cancellation / project-config-refusal tests still pass unchanged

tests.name: codex: a real runReadOnlySession call whose discovered servers include codex_app or cua_repl throws CodexMcpServerOverrideUnsafeError naming that server, and no tool from any server was reachable (the session never started)
codex: a real runReadOnlySession call whose discovered servers include only node_repl (and insrc) succeeds and starts a restricted session as today
codex: the previously-covered misregistration, budget/cancellation, and project-config-refusal tests remain unaffected by this Story's change
